purpose: On the complete frozen Stage1 A_0 own-state 0bp Tiered account, determine whether the already-produced predecision tail head gave unusually high readings before the two preidentified largest 2026Q3 SOXL-relative loss days, compared with every exposed positive/negative day and all 16 quarters. This is failure attribution, not a trading switch or evidence that the tail head predicts next-day relative loss.
statistics: Read only native analysis/daily once. Keep all 944 signals, every complete quarter and both endpoint partial years. For exposed days (SOXL_selection_log !=0), report tail_probability mean/median/q25/q75 separately for negative and positive contributions; retain zero-contribution counts. Report fixed two dates' signal/trade dates, alpha/tail probabilities, raw target beta, own cap, state and physical selection loss. Rank each tail_probability against all 944 predecision probabilities without turning the rank into a threshold. No matched-price label, coefficient, model fit or account replay.
interpretation_limits: Selection contribution sign is realized account outcome and risk_state is endogenous. Tail probability was trained for the original tail task, not for this one-day SOXL-minus-SOXX label. A post-hoc difference or its absence cannot certify a policy change; use only to decide whether a distinct source or receiver is needed.
stop: Any source hash, 944-row date identity, two fixed loss-day identity or original component mismatch stops. Do not set a tail threshold or select a new strategy from these realized groups.
